hits.description: Flexible B2B Financing for Your Customers: Effortless Growth for You, Frictionless Experience for Your Customers Credit Key's Buy Now Pay Later solution enables you to offer instant credit and flexible payment terms from Net 30 up to 12 months to your business customers at checkout. By integrating Credit Key with your BigCommerce store, you provide a seamless payment experience that drives higher conversion rates, increases average order value, and builds long-term customer loyalty. Why Integrate Credit Key? ✅ Instant Credit Decisions – Customers receive real-time decisions for a line of credit up to $50,000 with our AI-driven underwriting. ✅ Higher AOV & More Sales – Businesses spend more when they can make payments over time, allowing them to balance cash flow and purchasing needs. ✅ We Do the Heavy Lifting – We fund the transaction (while taking on the credit risk and handling collections), you get paid upfront, and your customers enjoy flexible repayment terms. ✅Seamless Checkout Experience – Fully embedded lending within your existing purchasing flow that allows customers to resolve financing needs at checkout. ✅ Streamline Accounting - Eliminate the hassle of managing accounts receivable and accounts payable, ensure faster payments, reduce manual invoicing, and simplify reconciliation. ✅ Simple, fast setup - Get approved as a Credit Key merchant and then seamlessly embed Credit Key within BigCommerce checkout.

It's frustrating, stressful and it limits your potential. Wayflyer provides flexible funding from $10K up to $20M, solving your cash flow problem and accelerating your growth. Flexible Funding We hate cookie-cutter funding. By tailoring every offer to your needs, we make sure you get the best terms. We also send funds directly to your account and don't restrict how you use them. Powerful Insights We give you more than just funding. Our powerful analytics dashboards will help you make better marketing decisions and our team of eCommerce experts will give you an edge over your competitors. Focused on Outcomes You've got big goals. We want to help you achieve them. In everything we do, we're focused on helping you grow faster, get more customers and achieve your goals. Your success is our success. Get funding today and join the thousands of eCommerce companies who use Wayflyer to accelerate their growth. Grow faster without the drawbacks Buy inventory, spend on marketing or invest in other areas of your business. With Wayflyer, you can get flexible funding from $10K up to $20M. Minimise your risk and keep ownership of your business as you grow. It's fast, flexible and at great rates.

B2B Buy Now, Pay Later INCREASE REVENUE: Drive sales, average order value and conversion by increasing the buying power of existing & potential customers INCREASE CASH FLOW: Unlock working capital and manage cash flow DECREASE RISK: Help mitigate risk of non-payment IMPROVE EFFICIENCY: Streamline AR workflow processes (ie credit check, payment portal, collections, reconciliation) & receive cash under one roof CUSTOMER CENTRIC: Offer a purchasing experience that is responsive to changing customer expectations - easy access to financing across all channels (offline and online) Your new customer net terms experience Your customers apply for terms during the checkout flow and are either instantly approved or decisioned in 24 hours. hits.title: Sezzle
hits.summary: Sezzle is an alternative payment platform that increases sales and basket sizes by enabling your customers to 'buy now and pay later'.
featuresList: Offer Sezzle Everywhere, Accept it Anywhere
hits.description: The only certified B-corp in Buy Now, Pay Later, Sezzle does good for shoppers and well for merchants. Loved by Millions of Shoppers With Sezzle, you can buy more, pay later. Split your order into 4 payments at 0% interest over 6 weeks, so that you get what you need, when you want. Trusted by +40K Merchants Sezzle supercharges your store's performance by turning more shoppers into buyers, boosting cart sizes, and unlocking access to millions of next-generation shoppers, who demand fairness, transparency, and flexibility in payment. Sezzle makes payment smart--not complicated--with simple merchant solutions that allow shoppers to flexibly finance any order--in-store or online--from $5 to $25,000. Integration is lightning-quick and button-click simple, and BigCommerce merchants get exclusive perks including: discounted processing rate one-day payout - collect payout six days faster Getting Started with Sezzle Submit an Application - submit an application to be a Sezzle merchant: https://get.sezzle.com/bigcommerce Connect to Sezzle - copy/paste the provided API keys into your BigCommerce dashboard: https://login.bigcommerce.com/deep-links/manage/settings/payment/sezzle and Enter Banking Info - connect your bank account to automatically deposit to your account.

summary.value: Sezzle is an alternative payment platform that increases sales and basket sizes by enabling your customers to 'buy now and pay later'.

hits.title: Credova
hits.summary: Credova is a consumer financing platform that by integrating into merchant’s checkout process, provides a buy now, pay later payment method.
hits.description: Better Buy Now Pay Later Credova is the buy now pay later company without product exclusions. Allow your customers to pay over time for anything in your store. The Credova plugin can provide multiple financing options to consumers on your website. Credova allows consumers to trigger a pop-up prequalification application and pre-approval prior to completing a full application. This allows the customer to shop knowing that they can spread out their cart total over time with affordable monthly payments. How to offer Credova Visit https://merchantinquiry.credova.com/ to book a demo and to complete onboarding documents & agreements. Obtain API Credentials, and Install the App. Obtain Dashboard Login and Authenticate Payment Information. Test your integration. Go live and start offering buy now, pay later. App Features: Shoppers can finance purchases up to $5000. No credit impact for shoppers to apply. Analytics and data platform for merchants. Promotional messaging on products. Prebuilt marketing collateral. Live account success team. U.S. based customer support team.

summary.value: Credova is a consumer financing platform that by integrating into merchant’s checkout process, provides a buy now, pay later payment method.

hits.title: Partial.ly Payment Plans
hits.summary: The Partial.ly app for BigCommerce lets you offer flexible payment plans to your customers.
hits.description: Partial.ly's app with BigCommerce is packed with features to help you grow sales, save abandoned orders, and make the payment process easier. You control the down payment, frequency, and duration of your payment plan offers, ensuring your terms meet your business needs. Partial.ly makes it easier for big-ticket purchases to suit your customer's finances. With Partial.ly, you can: Seamlessly integrate a flexible payment plan offer directly onto your cart page Allow customers to choose their terms when you enable flexibility Automate the payment processes so cash arrives in your bank account as scheduled Save abandoned orders Getting started You can get started quickly by following our Bigcommerce installation guide, which shows how simple it is to install Partial.ly on your BigCommerce store. If you get stuck, contact our great support team. When ready, you can sign up at partial.ly/register. It costs nothing to sign up, no credit card required, and no fixed or monthly fees. Only requires a Stripe account to process payments Simple pricing - 2% per successful transaction Partial.ly is used by over 6,500 businesses in 25 countries so you're in good company!

summary.value: The Partial.ly app for BigCommerce lets you offer flexible payment plans to your customers.

hits.title: Katapult
hits.summary: Katapult No Credit Required lease-to-own checkout solution for ecommerce.
hits.description: With Katapult, you can offer a lease-to-own checkout solution for the underserved subprime & no credit consumer market, allowing consumers who may not qualify for traditional financing find a path to ownership for the products they need. Katapult focuses on an omni-channel experience, partnering with both eCommerce and brick & mortar retailers nationwide. Consumers experience a user-friendly checkout process with three easy steps and only 14 required fields, making the application simple and fast with approvals in less than 5 seconds. Additionally, Katapult utilizes proprietary algorithms for approvals and does not rely on consumer FICO scores. At Katapult, we pride ourselves on the transparency of our agreements and our award winning customer service and 24/7 chat support. The Katapult app utilizes APIs to modify your payments page to accept Katapult as a payment option and is seamlessly embedded into your checkout flow via an iframe. Katapult handles all consumer application approvals, payment processing, and lease servicing. Our app also provides the functionality to manage post-origination functions from the BigCommerce admin portal, including cancel order/cancel item and order management through our APIs. In addition, we offer a full library of marketing assets, like pre-approval buttons and banners, for our retail partners as these are not natively built into the app.

summary.value: Katapult No Credit Required lease-to-own checkout solution for ecommerce.

hits.title: On-Demand Liquidity by Receive
hits.summary: Connect your BigCommerce storefront and bank account to instantly turn outstanding sales into spending power. Anytime. Anywhere. For free.
hits.description: Introducing Receive – the first-ever earned revenue access tool for sellers and small businesses. Receive provides on-demand liquidity for small businesses bridging the gap between you making a sale and receiving a payout. Receive eliminates the "time to money tax" with a zero interest, zero fee, no credit required solution that enables sellers to avoid costly and predatory loans. Unlike cumbersome and pricey loan applications or cash advances, our streamlined approach leverages your sales data to promptly grant access to cash within your earned revenue limits. There are no fees, no fixed repayment schedules, or APRs. Receive operates solely on the revenue you've already earned – no lending, purchasing receivables, or capital funding involved. Receive empowers small businesses with hassle-free access to cash, no strings attached. Say goodbye to credit checks and rigid repayment terms – with Receive, it's all about leveraging your sales data to unlock the liquidity you need, precisely when you need it. Boost your cash flow effortlessly and focus on what truly matters – growing your business.

summary.value: Connect your BigCommerce storefront and bank account to instantly turn outstanding sales into spending power. Anytime. Anywhere. For free.

consentPreferenceCenter.title: Privacy Preference Center
consentPreferenceCenter.description: When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

strictlyNecessary.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies
strictlyNecessary.description: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

functional.title: Functional Cookies
functional.description: These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

performance.title: Performance Cookies
performance.description: These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

targeting.title: Targeting Cookies
targeting.description: These cookies may be set through our site by us and/or our third-party service providers. They may be used by us and/or our third-party service providers to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites and/or devices. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
